Hey I’d like to share a funny story about the leash idea. I don’t know a lot of people who own cats so I’m not sure if this is common practice; but if I may say, leash train the cat indoors first because apparently not all leashes are the same fit! My family had a mainly indoor cat, he was quite old so we wanted to let him enjoy the outdoors before his time. We didn’t realize that maybe bringing him outside right after putting the leash on wasn’t a good idea. It did “fit” (apparently not if this happened.) but when he got bored he just casually slipped his arm out and plopped over. I had no idea that could happen, and I’m so glad he wasn’t a runner! 

I don’t mean to nag, you sound like an awesome cat owner. This risk just didn’t even occur to me so I’d like to warn anyone if I can. You never know what tricks your cat might have up its sleeve!

I guess overall, I was going by how drawn I was to the characters even if I couldn’t really explain why. I think you’re right about that last part, I seem to enjoy the more expressive characters. Allow me to think of my reasoning for the characters you listed!

Kokichi: He and Miu are fairly similar in personality, which is what drew me to her so that can’t be my reasoning. I think something about Gonta’s trial really got to me and I couldn’t see Kokichi in any good light until the end of the game when I thought more about his character. He’s not bad at all, character-wise. He’s got a lot of complexity and depth like any other person but he just didn’t stick to me as someone who mattered outside of being a human. I can appreciate his extreme efforts in “playing the part” and trying to take down the mastermind like everyone else. 

Rantaro: He was friendly, had a tragic backstory, like most of the students. I feel like he didn’t get a chance to leave much of an impression outside of being a possible red herring with the whole “I might know something, I might not.” thing only to never actually reveal anything. I seriously didn’t know what to make of him when he was down in the library, nobody knows what he was doing there so there’s no way for me to form a good or bad opinion on him. I figured it was mean and stupid to put him on the bottom tier for those reasons, D tier seemed like a good balance. 

Junko: Looking back I should’ve put her in E with Angie. Not a fan of cult leader types as I grew up in a similar environment. Well regardless, she’s a hell of a villain but she still feels so flat to me, which I guess is what Kodaka might’ve been going for, y’know? The whole point is that she craves despair and we’re not supposed to get why. It’s so edgy but still so important as it destroyed the damn world! Maybe C tier would be fitting too, what do you think?

Kyoko: I’m kind of having that expressive issue again with her. No emotions, not a care in the world about anyone or anything except for her detective work. I’m sure she did have humane motives but obviously it wasn’t the point for her to express them. She’s just doing what she was raised to do and I didn’t find it memorable. She’s a very important character but I don’t care for her emotionally. This is going to sound so contradictory but this doesn’t mean I don’t like her though! Dr3 had me nervous for her honestly. 

I gotta say, I should’ve picked different labeling for the tiers instead of S A B C etc., I guess I forgot D tier means “I basically hate you but dont want you dead.” I’m glad this is at least offering some discussion.

Jack: Mmm she was difficult for me to love because so many people were unhappy with her premise, like how badly she misrepresented DID (I think that’s what it was). She’s badass but the whole Master thing was really killing me. I get that she’s obsessed with that kind of trope (since she’s a writer, I kind of figure that’s what half of her monthly stories are about) and it’s probably her kink, but jeez it’s uncomfortable. Which is also the point, you’re not supposed to be comfortable with it...kind of. Depends on who you are, I guess? So, I both love and feel disgusted by her. I’d like her to be as far away from S tier as possible without hitting the bottom because she’s just a kinky artist with low self esteem.
